## Three-year comparison: Czech Wikipedia only has direct coverage

**Czech Wikipedia:** Still showing a **declining** trend over the three-year window (September 2023 – August 2026). The "Přerušovaný půst" article saw a **47.7% drop** in the last 12 months versus the year before (90% range: -62.5% to -27.9%, medium confidence). This decline was consistent across 11 of 12 months. The article averaged 146 views/month.

**Polish and Slovak:** Neither has a dedicated intermittent fasting article. 

Would you like me to include Polish and Slovak data using the **"Post" (fasting in general)** proxy for both? This would show broader fasting interest rather than intermittent fasting specifically, but would let us compare all three Central European markets over the three-year period.
